headword: {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}

definitions.gloss: credit limit; usage limit (amount); spending cap
definitions.explanation: The maximum amount that a user is permitted to charge, withdraw, or spend — most commonly the credit limit on a credit card, but also used for debit cards, prepaid cards, point services, and other usage-based accounts.

examples.japanese: {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧50{万円|まんえん}です。
⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げたい→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。
examples.english: I want to raise the credit limit on my credit card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}して→達する：02129_tassuru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I've already hit my credit limit for this month, so I can't use the card.

examples.japanese: ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}すれば→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧、{利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増額|ぞうがく}→増額：12134_zougaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you contact the card company, they may be able to temporarily raise your credit limit.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧ (use, utilization), ⟦{限度|げんど}→限度：00063_gendo⟧ (limit), and ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount, sum). The standard term used on credit card statements, banking apps, and service contracts in Japan to refer to the maximum chargeable or usable amount.

USAGE:
Most commonly seen in the context of credit cards (⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧), where it refers to the cardholder's credit limit. Also used for debit cards, prepaid cards, electronic money services, and subscription-style services that have a usage cap.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the credit limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the credit limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧ / ⟦{増額|ぞうがく}→増額：12134_zougaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to raise the limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧: to lower the limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧: setting of the limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{限度額|げんどがく}→限度額：20870_gendogaku⟧: limit amount — the more general term; {利用限度額|りようげんどがく} specifies that it is a use/spending limit
- {与信枠|よしんわく}: credit line — the bank-side term for the credit extended to a cardholder; more technical
- {利用可能額|りようかのうがく}: available credit — the amount currently available to spend, i.e., the limit minus what has already been used
